checks.facts: Exactly initialize, tools/list and five fixed active calls. One private qa_join transitions split to joined. cached_full uses the joined cache. No model or provider call.

Capture, installed prepare and service observe wrappers call the original once and save the same returned data. Parent validates original sidecar byte count/SHA and capture association. No extra prepare/discovery call is made by the acceptance controller.

Independent brief-v2 decoder compares objects, ROI rows, source provenance, coverage, all pixel rows, scope denominators and unsupported ranges to the actual raw service value. Full compares the complete declared public projection. Native blocks must equal saved PNG bytes and hashes at 512px.

Capture vertices/faces are checked exactly against frozen split/join fixtures and ordered world-triangle digest. Index checks expected 138 canonical quads/front/source-face lists plus six complete classification sets and matching masks. Current blocker geometry IDs are independently bound to actual capture triangles.

Oracle imports no product module. It independently constructs patch mappings from frozen axis answers and actual capture faces, validates all saved buffers/metadata/PNG and recomputes one four-neighbor boundary plus all 138 ROI rows, including negatives. It invokes no raster.

Exactly five AB/BA alternating pairs on the existing split SCENE arrays. Each reference builds one shared contrast boundary and scans 138 masks. Installed optimized uses shared aggregation. Counts compare pairwise. No warmup, extra discovery or raster. Individual clocks cover the count call, with setup/comparison/publication separated.

READY handles missing/partial JSON within the original deadline, checks held process and verifies PID/source metadata. Stdio constructor failures including reader-start failures enter cleanup. Held wait/kill/wait, reader join, pipe close and handle close are independently attempted. A live reader defers stdout close and makes cleanup unconfirmed.

Durable exclusive global attempt slots and INTENT records precede the actual raster callback. Hard cap14 is independent of case completion. Parent checks exact marker/ledger counts and <=12 newly completed frames. Per-case progress files are unique. No reused PROGRESS.json exclusive-write collision.

Wheel replaces manifest sources, verifies RECORD and installed bytes in isolated product target. Unit runner blocks Blender starts and all three raster aliases. Numerical preflight compares full split/join cameras and camera/NDC vertex arithmetic exactly before the real raster budget. Registered65 is a parent expectation, with actual result still pending.

resolved_findings.original_issue: normalize_index attempted to pop object_index/triangle_index from first_blocker. Current core publishes only triangle_geometry_id and overlap_area_screen_exact.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final oracle accepts the actual two-field shape, independently hashes canonical captured triangles and requires positive exact area. Geometry IDs and area remain unchanged for split/join comparison.
resolved_findings.phase: pre-freeze static correction, zero candidate execution

reviewer_corrections.initial_error: Reviewer mixed the controller JSONL encoded helper with the independent delivery helper and incorrectly claimed the draw hash included a newline.
reviewer_corrections.correction: Delivery encoded never appended a newline. The original draw hash was equivalent. Final source makes the no-newline canonical serialization explicit. This is a reviewer mistake, not a runtime failure.
